notes: The Forest core scene registry is exported for all levels 1-100.

Authored world facts, choices, encounter routing, encounter presentation kernels, Story primitive contracts, Knowledge UX presentation definitions and late-world structures are exported as separate runtime registries.
Ordinary core levels reuse shared procedural Story generation instead of per-level implementations.
TBD weights, final dialogue, final art/voice and non-blocking mastery tuning remain explicit and are never inferred by runtime export.
Relationship synthesis, required revisit, world synthesis and elemental manifestation have generic runtimes; SYN_FOREST_WORLD_01_BOARD v0.01 is the beta-runnable production draft for level 99.
Knowledge UI consumes a spoiler-safe projection and never receives hidden subject identity, raw relationship evidence event ids, unresolved question keys or Cognition state.
Relation runtime accepts only explicitly exported authored ID pairs; no semantic inference is allowed.
